entries.observableGoal: Make a cut preserve a deliberate visual relationship between adjacent shots.
forbiddenAssumptions: a semantic resemblance is also a geometric match
a transition effect can repair a poor alignment
source handles exist without inspection
entries.neutralMechanism: Compare the measurable visual relationship at the outgoing and incoming boundary, then accept only a source-window and geometry choice that stays inside declared tolerances.

entries.observableGoal: Change timing or music emphasis without losing, masking, or reordering speech.
requiredEvidence: word-timed transcript or protected dialogue ranges
forbiddenAssumptions: silence is safe to remove without word timing
a nearby beat is safe during dialogue
music gain outside speech may change
entries.neutralMechanism: Bind the proposed range to measured speech and audio evidence, reject overlap with protected words, and confine any gain change to the declared dialogue interval with restoration afterward.

entries.observableGoal: Use repeated footage as an intentional callback while avoiding accidental duplicate source windows.
forbiddenAssumptions: all repetition is undesirable
the same asset implies the same frames
a different asset is automatically more varied
entries.neutralMechanism: Evaluate repetition against narrative intent: preserve a requested callback when its source windows and actions are distinct, while penalising accidental duplicate frames elsewhere.
failureModes: repetition has no declared narrative role

entries.observableGoal: Reconstruct observable layout and motion relationships from a reference using owned source material.
forbiddenAssumptions: the reference is renderable source media
fixed semantic slot names apply to every design
a generated-code path is required
panel count may be guessed when evidence is ambiguous
entries.neutralMechanism: Represent the reference as measured spatial, temporal, layering, typography, and continuity relationships; select only source windows that can satisfy those relationships without copying reference pixels.

entries.observableGoal: Adapt canvas shape while keeping a moving subject visible and authored overlays stable.
forbiddenAssumptions: a static center crop follows a moving subject
authored overlays belong inside the media crop
missing track samples may be interpolated without a declared tolerance
entries.neutralMechanism: Change the canvas, derive media geometry from bound spatial samples, and preserve independently authored overlay relationships instead of treating every layer as one flattened image.
failureModes: spatial track has an unsafe gap

entries.observableGoal: Keep a changing foreground contour in front of a separately controlled background or title over time.
forbiddenAssumptions: a static rectangle equals a moving matte
layer reordering creates partial per-pixel occlusion
whole-frame filtering equals regional grading
segmentation evidence may be invented
entries.neutralMechanism: Per-pixel occlusion requires a time-varying isolation signal that separates foreground from background across the range; ordinary rectangular geometry or whole-layer ordering cannot substitute for it.

entries.observableGoal: Use only media whose identity, tenant scope, rights, and egress authority are explicit.
forbiddenAssumptions: a remote search result is licensed
a URL is durable asset identity
network access is implied by a creative request
an unrelated owned asset is an acceptable substitute
entries.neutralMechanism: Resolve candidates only inside the authorized manifest; when none exists, preserve project state and request an upload or separately authorized retrieval path.

entries.observableGoal: Keep a proposed edit bound to the exact project revision and evidence snapshot it was planned against.
forbiddenAssumptions: overlay ranges remain valid after another edit
a stale plan may force overwrite
creative intent must be re-asked when only state is stale
entries.neutralMechanism: Compare the envelope revision with current project evidence before any mutation; a mismatch produces a structured replan request and preserves the current state.

entries.observableGoal: Keep timed captions semantically aligned after a transcript-based edit without silently redesigning their presentation.
forbiddenAssumptions: caption text may remain for deleted speech
retiming authorizes a font or color change
repeated phrases are interchangeable
entries.neutralMechanism: Resolve the exact speech occurrence, update caption membership and timing from surviving words, and preserve the existing presentation unless redesign authority is explicit.
